description: Order history returns 401; the test's token is fresh, but the orders service cannot validate it because its own staging client secret has expired.
howSeeded: Let the staging orders-service client secret pass its 90-day expiry without rotating it in the secret store.
decidingEvidence: The identity provider rejecting the orders service's own client credentials as expired, while the test's user token was minted seconds earlier and never cached.
twinAxis: The same 401 on the same endpoint. There the test reused its own expired token; here the test's token is fresh and the environment's service credential has expired.
